items.name: Airlie Oak Wilmington Throw Pillow
items.alt: Ivory square throw pillow printed with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, a Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss, on a white wicker porch chair beside a fern, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed square throw pillow with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, on warm ivory. Two sizes, made to order.
facts: Airlie Oak illustration on the front and back, not embroidered
